thread:
Tim (Sales): quick context — BrightWave trial is wrapping, they intend to convert to paid. Primary use case: customer-facing FAQ/chat on web. They require Okta SSO, data residency in us-east, and want predictable latency. Estimated ARR if Dedicated: ~$90k/yr. Go-live target: ~6 weeks.
Sarah (CS): thanks for the context. tagging owners — Nora will run onboarding and renewal cadence, Lee will own SSO/infrastructure. Nora/Lee, can you confirm next steps and any blockers?
Nora (CSM): got it. I'll own onboarding schedule & enablement. Proposing a 60-min enablement + ops sync w/ BrightWave on Tue 2026-04-11 10:00 PT. I'll send the invite and quickstart deck today.
Lee (Eng): noted. Immediate asks from my side: we need their Okta metadata XML, an admin test user, and the list of outbound IPs they expect us to allowlist. Also confirm whether they want VPC peering or a connector for Private mode — that affects the infra work.
Tim (Sales): adding links and timeline: Okta metadata uploaded to drive -> https://drive.redwood/bw/okta-metadata.pdf. PO expected week of 2026-04-24. I'll follow up with procurement details.
Tim (Sales): Finance asked for a per-token cost breakdown by tier for the proposal — Nora, can CS/Eng provide an estimate to include in the PO message?
Nora (CSM): action items I have now: 1) attach enablement deck + quickstart guide to ticket 2) create onboarding ticket CS-7819 and link ENG-2432 for SSO 3) schedule enablement call 4) capture their evaluation prompts and success metrics.
infra-bot: Ticket created: CS-7819 (BrightWave onboarding) — linked to ENG-2432 for SSO work. Owner: Nora (CSM). ETA: 2026-04-10.
Lee (Eng): ENG-2432 noted. I'll scope SSO work in the next 48h. Please provide the Okta metadata + a test admin account. Also need their network egress IPs for allowlist and expected request rate (rps) so we can size Dedicated capacity or advise on Hosted vs Dedicated.
Sarah (CS): adding a renewal risk flag: Tim flagged price sensitivity and procurement delays. Recommend a 12-month commit discount conversation after initial success metrics are met. Nora, please add renewal_watch to the account record and set weekly check-ins until go-live.
Nora (CSM): renewal_watch=true added. Check-in cadence: weekly until go-live, then 30/60/90-day business reviews. I'll collect feedback from their ML product team during onboarding and add notes to CS-7819.
Tim (Sales): last ask from sales side — can Support/Eng prepare a short post-go-live incident runbook (escalation path + common checks) so BrightWave has a clear contact flow?
Lee (Eng): yes — we'll prepare a concise runbook and attach to ENG-2432. Runbook will include: 1) how to reproduce common token errors 2) who to ping for SLA incidents 3) quick remediation steps. I'll paste a snippet here when ready.
Nora (CSM): I'll capture enablement feedback via a short form and attach results to CS-7819. Also can Sales intro the customer's CISO to our security docs for Private deployment checklist? They asked for SOC2 artifacts.
Tim (Sales): intro sent via email and cc'd here: ciso@brightwave.example. They asked specifically for SOC2 Type II report + encryption detail docs. I'll add that to the ticket.
Sarah (CS): summary of owners & next steps: Nora (CSM) — onboarding + enablement + renewal cadence; Lee (Eng) — SSO scoping + runbook + ENG tasks; Tim (Sales) — procurement & security contact; infra-bot — ticket tracking. Nora: please post an update to this thread after the enablement call with any blockers. :thumbsup:
